info.title: A2Z Blueprint Cascade API
info.description: FastAPI endpoints for the Target Cascade module. All endpoints require JWT bearer authentication. Built v10.413 (E7) per React front-end requirement. Wraps pure-compute engines: cascade_health_engine, manager_rollup, pillar_impact_engine, kpi_ownership_pairing, target_scenario_simulator, capacity_feedback_engine, cascade_structure_engine.
